This plan costs 106 minutes. Only Galchhi shelter is a designated evacuation point, so Panchakanya school is not used.

- **Trip 1:** Go to Nilkantha market (9 minutes) and load its 3 adults. Return to Galchhi shelter (9 minutes) and unload them.
- **Trip 2:** Go to Gosaikunda farm (24 minutes) and load the 3 injured and 1 adult, filling the car. Return to Galchhi shelter (24 minutes) and unload them.
- **Deferred:** The other 2 adults at Gosaikunda farm are deferred, at 20 each. A third trip would cost 48 minutes to save 40, so it isn't worth it.

Total: 18 + 48 minutes of driving + 40 penalty = 106.
